title: Taça de Portugal 3rd Round Draw Stirs Up Clubs from All Divisions
seoTitle: Taça de Portugal 3rd Round Draw: Key Matchups Revealed
subtitle: Discover the confirmed fixtures and their impact on teams like Lamelas and Vitória de Guimarães
excerpt: The Taça de Portugal 3rd Round draw, held at Cidade do Futebol, set up clashes between clubs from different divisions, generating great excitement.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Taça de Portugal 3rd Round draw, held this Wednesday at Cidade do Futebol, defined the matchups between 14 top-tier teams and clubs from lower divisions. The event, hosted by Éder, brought highly anticipated clashes and marked the first phase without the presence of the five clubs competing in European competitions.

First Phase Matchups

Among the announced matches, highlights include the clash between Estoril and Salgueiros, Vitória de Guimarães' visit to the district of Lamelas, and Arouca's test against Belenenses. Other encounters include Famalicão playing away at Paredes, Tondela against Alverca, and Santa Clara in Mafra.

District Club Hosts First Division Team

Luís Morais, president of Lamelas, celebrated the draw that pitted his Viseu District League club against Vitória de Guimarães, from Liga Betclic. In an interview with Record, Morais described the matchup as "a historic milestone" for the club and highlighted the visibility the event would bring to his hometown.

Challenge for Lamelas

The director acknowledged the difference in reality between the two teams, stating that the outcome would be challenging, but that the opportunity to play against a first-division opponent is extremely valuable. Morais maintained a cautious stance regarding the possibility of an upset, highlighting the difficulty of such a feat.

European Teams Await Next Round

Benfica, Sporting, FC Porto, SC Braga, and Torreense, all participating in European competitions, were exempt from the 3rd Round and will only enter in the next phase. This regulation keeps the focus on the clubs still competing in the initial phase.

Expectations for Other Matchups

In addition to the spotlight on Lamelas, the schedule includes clashes between Académica and Amarante, Farense against Marco, UD Leiria with Bragança, and the classic encounter between Penafiel and Leça. The variety of duels promises excitement across the country, with clubs of different levels seeking Taça glory.

With information from A Bola, SAPO.
